newsitem.title: USA: Dow Chemical says claim against it dismissed.
newsitem.headline: Dow Chemical says claim against it dismissed.

text.p: Dow Chemical Co said Tuesday that, as expected, Louisiana Civil District Court ruled Monday that Dow Chemical cannot be tried on the claim of strict product liability in the Spitzfaden class action silicone breast implant litigation here.
The company said three claims still stand against it: fraudulent misrepresentation and concealment; civil conspiracy; and aiding and abetting.
It said the court ruled the devices were legally products of Dow Corning Corp, in which Dow Chemical and Corning Inc each is a 50-percent shareholder.
The company said the judge's finding is consistent with those of every other court in the country in addressing the products liability issue.
Most plaintiffs have not brought this claim against Dow Chemical and, when they have, it has always been dismissed, the company said.
